about: Shakti Polytarp manufactures tarpaulins (sold under the Dinotarp brand) and shade nets at its plant in Nimrani, Khargone, Madhya Pradesh, and also trades plastic granules. It sells mainly B2B to construction, agriculture and transport users. FY26 revenue was Rs 215.65 crore, with traded goods about 48% of sales.
sector: Plastics - Tarpaulin and Shade Net Manufacturing

peers.name: Shree Tirupati Balajee Agro Trading Company Ltd

objects.purpose: Capital expenditure - purchase of plant and machinery (shade net and printing lines)
General corporate purposes (capped at lower of 15% of issue or Rs 10 crore)

promoters.background: Promoters have 9 to 17 years of experience in the business; Ravi Singhal is Managing Director. Several promoter-family relatives run firms that trade with the company.

concentration.note: Top 1 customer 41.16%, top 5 69.54%, top 10 77.86% of FY26 revenue; Madhya Pradesh is 91.77% of revenue.

litigation_note: No outstanding litigation against the company, promoters or directors. One group entity has 3 tax proceedings totalling Rs 1.25 lakh.
strengths: Wide range of tarpaulin products (geotextile, lumber wrap, house wrap, pond liners, green net) serving agriculture, construction and logistics.
In-house manufacturing at one integrated plant in Khargone, Madhya Pradesh, helping control quality and cost.
Revenue grew from Rs 62.01 crore in FY24 to Rs 215.65 crore in FY26.
PAT rose to Rs 10.06 crore in FY26 from Rs 0.98 crore in FY24; RoNW 44.04% in FY26.
EBITDA margin improved from 6.18% to 8.94% over FY24-FY26.
Installed capacity rose to 12,900 MTPA by March 2026 from 4,200 MTPA in FY24.
Capex proceeds will fund shade net and printing machinery, with Rs 7.86 crore already paid as advances.
Experienced promoter team and no outstanding litigation against the company or promoters.

risks.title: Heavy customer concentration
risks.detail: Top 1 customer was 41.16% and top 5 were 69.54% of FY26 revenue (top 1 was 52.97% in FY25). Losing a major customer would hurt sharply.

risks.title: High debt and thin liquidity
risks.detail: Borrowings of Rs 72.51 crore against net worth of Rs 27.86 crore (debt/equity 2.60). Current ratio fell to 0.86 in FY26 and cash was only Rs 0.26 crore.

risks.title: Negative operating cash flow history
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was negative Rs 10.79 crore in FY25 and Rs 2.05 crore in FY24 due to working capital build-up; FY26 turned positive at Rs 13.40 crore.

risks.title: Dependence on one state
risks.detail: Madhya Pradesh contributed 91.77% of FY26 revenue (95.35% in FY25). A local slowdown would hit sales.

risks.title: Low-margin trading and supplier concentration
risks.detail: Granule trading was about 48% of FY26 revenue at low margins (PAT margin 4.66%). Top 10 suppliers provide 56% to 90% of raw material; top 1 supplier was Rs 109.16 crore in FY26.

risks.title: Related-party dealings
risks.detail: Sales to promoter-relative firm Shri Balaji Plastopack were Rs 4.18 crore (1.94% of revenue) in FY26; purchases from Tripal Traders were Rs 0.75 crore, with promoter-family unsecured loans also outstanding.

risks.title: Fast growth and dilution with unfinalised price
risks.detail: Revenue jumped 168% in FY25 and 29.7% in FY26. Issue price is not yet fixed; weighted average EPS is Rs 5.52 and promoters will hold 64.92% post-issue.

risks.title: Subsidy and plastics regulation risk
risks.detail: Capital subsidy of up to 40% under the MP MSME scheme is uncertain, and stricter rules on plastics could hurt the business. The company has also paid penalties for late GST and tax filings.

notes: FY26 restated standalone, Rs lakh converted to Rs crore. Price band, issue size, P/E and general corporate purposes amount are blank in the RHP. Issue is 45,64,000 fresh shares including 2,30,000 for the market maker; reservation percentages are for the net issue (QIB up to 50%). Balance sheet columns were garbled in extraction and reconstructed from totals (net worth, working capital, debt/equity cross-checks). Cash is cash and cash equivalents only. Capex funded earlier via SIDBI bridge loan of Rs 5.98 crore. No contingent liabilities.
